special_rules: 1-bit line art (solid black artwork) is judged at twice the normal resolution: hard edges show ragged on fabric.

source.notes: Printify's tee catalog has many products with their own print areas; we picked the Gildan 5000 (marked 'Bestseller' in Printify's own catalog, the same role Bella+Canvas 3001 plays for Printful) as the representative product, the same choice pattern used for Printful. Confirmed 2026-09-27 directly in Printify's Product Creator (product 6, DTG, https://printify.com/app/editor/6/99/dtg): its own 'Print area size' panel reads 3951 x 4919 px at DPI 300 for the FRONT, size L -- exactly 13.17x16.4in, which is what's now stored (previously this held an unrelated 15x17in with no known source). Printify shows a 'Product size' control next to that panel, so this may vary by garment size the way Printful's front print area does; only size L was checked. Format/DPI/file-size guidance (JPEG/PNG/SVG; 300 DPI recommended, 120-150 for large-format products; 100MB max for JPEG/PNG) is confirmed generically by Printify's own help article (quoted in evidence). cmyk_accepted=false and the PNG/RGB special rule are our own carry-over assumptions, not confirmed by either page.
